parameters.query:
WITH p AS (
  SELECT $1::jsonb AS x
),

chan AS (
  INSERT INTO yt_growth.channels (
    channel_id,
    config
  )
  SELECT
    x#>>'{config,channel_id}',
    x->'config'
  FROM p
  ON CONFLICT (channel_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    config = excluded.config,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING *
),

approval AS (
  INSERT INTO yt_growth.approvals (
    job_id,
    status,
    actor,
    approved_revision,
    details
  )
  SELECT
    j.job_id,
    CASE
      WHEN p.x#>>'{input,action}' = 'approve'
      THEN 'APPROVED'
      ELSE 'REJECTED'
    END,
    p.x#>>'{input,actor}',
    j.revision,
    jsonb_build_object(
      'execution_id', p.x->>'execution_id',
      'artifact_hash', j.payload#>>'{data,render,video,sha256}'
    )
  FROM p
  JOIN yt_growth.production_jobs j
    ON j.job_id = p.x->>'job_key'
   AND j.channel_id = p.x#>>'{config,channel_id}'
  WHERE
    p.x->>'trigger' = 'webhook'
    AND p.x#>>'{input,action}' IN ('approve','reject')
    AND j.stage = 'approval'
    AND j.state = 'APPROVAL'
    AND (
      j.lease_until IS NULL
      OR j.lease_until < now()
    )
  ON CONFLICT (job_id)
  DO UPDATE SET
    status = excluded.status,
    actor = excluded.actor,
    approved_revision = excluded.approved_revision,
    details = excluded.details,
    updated_at = now()
  RETURNING *
),

newjob AS (
  INSERT INTO yt_growth.production_jobs (
    job_id,
    channel_id,
    payload,
    lease_owner,
    lease_until
  )
  SELECT
    x->>'job_key',
    x#>>'{config,channel_id}',
    jsonb_build_object(
      'job_id', x->>'job_key',
      'stage', 'collect',
      'state', 'CLAIMED',
      'data', '{}'::jsonb,
      'cost', 0,
      'tokens', 0,
      'attempts', '{}'::jsonb,
      'mode', x#>>'{input,mode}',
      'publish_version', 1,
      'workflow_version', 2,
      'dry_run', (x#>>'{config,dry_run}')::boolean,
      'repair_count', 0,
      'render_revision', 0,
      'active_ms', 0,
      'checkpoint', 'CREATED',
      'event', 'JOB_CREATED'
    ),
    x->>'execution_id',
    now() + interval '15 minutes'
  FROM p
  WHERE
    x#>>'{input,action}' = 'run'
    AND (
      x->>'trigger' <> 'scheduled'
      OR (
        (SELECT next_cycle_at FROM chan) <= now()
        AND NOT EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM yt_growth.production_jobs j2
          WHERE
            j2.channel_id = x#>>'{config,channel_id}'
            AND j2.state NOT IN (
              'COMPLETED',
              'FAILED',
              'REJECTED',
              'DEAD_LETTER',
              'DRY_RUN_DONE',
              'WATCH'
            )
        )
      )
    )
  ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
  RETURNING *
),

target AS (
  SELECT
    j.*
  FROM yt_growth.production_jobs j
  CROSS JOIN p
  WHERE
    j.channel_id = p.x#>>'{config,channel_id}'
    AND j.payload->>'workflow_version' = '2'
    AND (
      j.lease_until IS NULL
      OR j.lease_until < now()
    )
    AND (
      (
        p.x->>'trigger' = 'scheduled'
        AND j.due_at <= now()
        AND j.state NOT IN (
          'COMPLETED',
          'FAILED',
          'REJECTED',
          'APPROVAL',
          'PUBLISH_UNCERTAIN',
          'DEAD_LETTER',
          'DRY_RUN_DONE',
          'WATCH'
        )
      )
      OR
      (
        p.x->>'trigger' <> 'scheduled'
        AND j.job_id = p.x->>'job_key'
        AND j.state NOT IN (
          'COMPLETED',
          'REJECTED',
          'DEAD_LETTER',
          'DRY_RUN_DONE',
          'WATCH'
        )
        AND (
          j.state NOT IN (
            'FAILED',
            'PUBLISH_UNCERTAIN',
            'APPROVAL'
          )
          OR p.x#>>'{input,action}' IN (
            'approve',
            'reject',
            'retry',
            'reconcile'
          )
        )
      )
    )
  ORDER BY j.due_at
  LIMIT 1
  FOR UPDATE SKIP LOCKED
),

claimed_existing AS (
  UPDATE yt_growth.production_jobs AS j
  SET
    lease_owner = p.x->>'execution_id',
    lease_until = now() + interval '15 minutes',
    state = CASE
      WHEN j.state = 'QUEUED' THEN 'CLAIMED'
      ELSE j.state
    END,
    updated_at = now()
  FROM target AS t
  CROSS JOIN p
  WHERE
    j.job_id = t.job_id
    AND (
      j.lease_owner IS NULL
      OR j.lease_until IS NULL
      OR j.lease_until < now()
    )
  RETURNING j.*
),

claimed AS (
  SELECT *
  FROM newjob

  UNION ALL

  SELECT *
  FROM claimed_existing
)

SELECT
  p.x
  || jsonb_build_object(
    'job',
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT
          payload
          || jsonb_build_object(
            'revision', revision,
            'state', state,
            'retry_count', retry_count,
            'lease_owner', lease_owner,
            'lease_until', lease_until
          )
        FROM claimed
        LIMIT 1
      ),
      (
        SELECT
          payload
          || jsonb_build_object(
            'revision', revision,
            'state', state,
            'retry_count', retry_count,
            'lease_owner', lease_owner,
            'lease_until', lease_until
          )
        FROM target
        LIMIT 1
      )
    ),

    'needs_claim',
    NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1
      FROM claimed
    ),

    'approval',
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT to_jsonb(a)
        FROM approval a
      ),
      (
        SELECT to_jsonb(a2)
        FROM yt_growth.approvals a2
        WHERE a2.job_id = p.x->>'job_key'
      )
    ),

    'memory',
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT jsonb_agg(data)
        FROM (
          SELECT data
          FROM yt_growth.learning_events
          WHERE channel_id = p.x#>>'{config,channel_id}'
          ORDER BY updated_at DESC
          LIMIT 12
        ) m
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    ),

    'dna',
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT data
        FROM yt_growth.channel_dna
        WHERE channel_id = p.x#>>'{config,channel_id}'
        ORDER BY updated_at DESC
        LIMIT 1
      ),
      '{}'::jsonb
    ),

    'past_failures',
    COALESCE(
      (
        SELECT jsonb_agg(error)
        FROM (
          SELECT e.error
          FROM yt_growth.errors e
          JOIN yt_growth.production_jobs j3
            USING (job_id)
          WHERE j3.channel_id = p.x#>>'{config,channel_id}'
          ORDER BY e.created_at DESC
          LIMIT 8
        ) z
      ),
      '[]'::jsonb
    )
  ) AS envelope
FROM p;

WITH p AS(SELECT $1::jsonb x),u AS(UPDATE yt_growth.production_jobs j SET lease_owner=p.x->>'execution_id',lease_until=now()+interval '15 minutes',state=CASE WHEN j.state='QUEUED' THEN 'CLAIMED' ELSE j.state END FROM p WHERE j.job_id=p.x->>'job_id' AND (j.lease_owner=p.x->>'execution_id' OR j.lease_until IS NULL OR j.lease_until<now()) RETURNING j.job_id) SELECT CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM u) THEN x ELSE x || '{"dispatch":"idle"}'::jsonb END AS envelope FROM p;

parameters.query: WITH p AS(SELECT $1::jsonb x),l AS(INSERT INTO yt_growth.dead_letter(job_id,stage,reason,checkpoint_revision,context) SELECT x->>'job_id',x->>'stage',coalesce(x#>>'{error,message}','Dead letter'),(x->>'revision')::bigint,jsonb_build_object('qa_report',x#>'{data,qa_report}','retry_count',x->'retry_count','repair_count',x->'repair_count','error',x->'error') FROM p ON CONFLICT(job_id) DO UPDATE SET reason=excluded.reason,context=excluded.context RETURNING job_id),u AS(UPDATE yt_growth.production_jobs j SET state='DEAD_LETTER',payload=x-'schemas'-'config'-'response'-'request',last_error=x->'error',error_message=x#>>'{error,message}',lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,due_at='infinity',updated_at=now() FROM p WHERE j.job_id=x->>'job_id' AND j.lease_owner=x->>'execution_id' RETURNING j.job_id),e AS(INSERT INTO yt_growth.errors(job_id,execution_id,error) SELECT x->>'job_id',x->>'execution_id',coalesce(x->'error',jsonb_build_object('message','Dead letter')) FROM p RETURNING id) SELECT jsonb_build_object('job_id',x->>'job_id','state','DEAD_LETTER','error',x->'error','error_id',(SELECT id FROM e)) AS alert FROM p;

WITH p AS(SELECT $1::jsonb x),u AS(UPDATE yt_growth.production_jobs j SET retry_count=j.retry_count+1,state=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM yt_growth.publishing_records r WHERE r.job_id=j.job_id AND r.video_id IS NULL) THEN 'PUBLISH_UNCERTAIN' WHEN j.retry_count+1>=j.max_retries THEN 'DEAD_LETTER' ELSE 'RETRY' END,last_error=x->'error',error_message=x#>>'{error,message}',due_at=CASE WHEN j.retry_count+1>=j.max_retries OR EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM yt_growth.publishing_records r WHERE r.job_id=j.job_id AND r.video_id IS NULL) THEN 'infinity'::timestamptz ELSE now()+interval '1 minute' END,lease_owner=NULL,lease_until=NULL,updated_at=now() FROM p WHERE j.lease_owner=x->>'execution_id' RETURNING j.*),l AS(INSERT INTO yt_growth.dead_letter(job_id,stage,reason,checkpoint_revision,context) SELECT job_id,stage,error_message,revision,last_error FROM u WHERE state='DEAD_LETTER' ON CONFLICT(job_id) DO UPDATE SET reason=excluded.reason,context=excluded.context RETURNING job_id),e AS(INSERT INTO yt_growth.errors(job_id,execution_id,error) SELECT (SELECT job_id FROM u LIMIT 1),x->>'execution_id',x->'error' FROM p RETURNING id) SELECT jsonb_build_object('job_id',(SELECT job_id FROM u LIMIT 1),'execution_id',x->>'execution_id','state',coalesce((SELECT state FROM u LIMIT 1),'CONFIGURATION_OR_DATABASE_FAILURE'),'error',x->'error','error_id',(SELECT id FROM e)) AS alert FROM p;
